company.name: SD Centre for Entrepreneurship Excellence
company.shortDescription: SDCEE is the premier centre for individuals looking to build and develop their entrepreneurial skills to create a successful venture.
company.description:
AT SDCEE, We believe that entrepreneurship is the primary driving force for innovation and sustainable economic growth. To this end—in collaboration with Erasmus Centre for Entrepreneurship, Dubai Technology Entrepreneur Campus (Dtec), and Dubai Silicon Oasis (DSO) —we have launched the SD Centre for Entrepreneurship Excellence (SDCEE).

Located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, SDCEE is the premier centre for individuals looking to build and develop their entrepreneurial skills to create a successful venture.

With over 200+ years of collective industrial experience of its founders and mentors, SDCEE is focused towards promoting entrepreneurial excellence through exceptional mentorship, entrepreneurship training programs, and consulting services.

Our programs have been designed to combine rigorous, updated curriculum with practical learning to maximize real-world application and impact.
